home.title: Your workspace
home.notice.title: The jobs' screens are coming
home.notice.body: You are signed in. The screens for the pilot's jobs follow in the next versions of the workspace.
home.jobs.title: Coming to the workspace

home.jobs.count.one: %d job is planned for the pilot.
home.jobs.count.other: %d jobs are planned for the pilot.

status.title: Service status
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The page you asked for does not exist, or is not yours to see.
home.companies.title: Your companies
home.companies.none: You have no company to work in yet. Ask your company's ERP administrator for access.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Enter your company's sign-in code. You will then sign in at your company's own identity provider.
signin.code.label: Sign-in code
signin.code.hint: Your administrator gives you the code. It is also the last part of the sign-in address you were sent.
signin.invalid: A sign-in code has 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
signin.unknown: No company uses this sign-in code. Check it with your administrator.
signin.error.title: There is a problem
signin.failed.title: Sign-in could not be completed
signin.failed.body: Your company's identity provider did not confirm the sign-in, or it took too long. Start again.
signin.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again in a few minutes.
signin.stepup.body: Your company requires a second factor for this, and your identity provider did not confirm one. Sign in again with your second factor.
continue.title: Continue to your workspace
continue.body: Your browser is taking you to the page. If nothing happens, use the link.
signedout.title: You are signed out
signedout.body: Your session in the workspace has ended. To be sure no one else can use it, close the browser if you share this computer.
refused.title: This request was refused
refused.body: It did not carry the page's security token, or it came from another site. Go back, reload the page and try again.
inbox.title: Approvals waiting for you
inbox.lead: The requests you may decide now, newest first. Open one to see its steps and decide it.
inbox.empty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
inbox.list.label: Requests waiting for you
inbox.barred.title: Your approvals are on hold
inbox.barred.body: You hold permissions that a segregation-of-duties rule keeps apart, so you cannot use them until an administrator removes one of them:
inbox.done.title: Decision recorded
inbox.refused.title: The approval requests could not be shown
agent.text: An agent wrote this. It is shown as plain text: check it before you decide.
request.title: Approval request
decide.title: Your decision
decide.comment.label: Comment (optional)
decide.comment.hint: At most 2,000 characters. It is recorded with your approval.
decide.reason.label: Reason for rejecting
decide.reason.hint: Required, at most 2,000 characters. The requester sees it.
decide.comment.long: A comment has at most 2,000 characters.
decide.own: You asked for this approval. Someone else decides it.
decide.notyours: You may not decide this request: it needs the step's role and the permission to approve this kind of object.
decide.closed: Nothing is left to decide: the request is no longer waiting.
refusal.title: The decision was not recorded
problem.workflow.already_approved: You have already approved this request. The next approval is someone else's.
problem.workflow.not_pending: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.
problem.workflow.own_request: You asked for this approval, so you cannot decide it.
problem.workflow.role_missing: You do not hold the role this step needs.
problem.workflow.segregation_of_duties: You took part in this work, so segregation of duties keeps you from approving it.
problem.workflow.request_pending: Another approval for the same object is still waiting.
problem.request.version_mismatch: The request changed since you opened it. Check it again, then decide.
problem.identity.permission_missing: You do not have the permission this needs.
problem.identity.sod_conflict: A segregation-of-duties rule bars this: you hold permissions it keeps apart.
problem.identity.agent_not_allowed: Only a person may decide approvals.
problem.request.not_found: The request does not exist, or is not yours to see.
problem.request.invalid_body: The decision could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.validation_failed: Something in the decision is not valid. Check the comment and try again.
problem.request.idempotency_key_reused: This form was already sent with other content. Reload the page and decide again.
problem.ledger.period_not_open: The posting period is not open, so the entry cannot be posted on approval.
invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.lead: Supplier invoices, latest invoice date first. Choose a status, or filter by company, supplier, number or date; open an invoice to match, post or decide it.
invoices.list.label: Supplier invoices
invoices.refused.title: The invoices could not be shown
filter.supplier: Only the invoices of one supplier:
filter.date.invalid: Enter a date as year-month-day, for example 2026-03-10.
filter.invalid: A filter in the address is not valid. Clear the filters and choose them again.
invoice.title: Supplier invoice
invoice.order.none: None: the invoice is posted to accounts
invoice.agent: An agent entered this invoice from a document. It is a proposal: check it against the document before you post it.
lines.title: Lines
lines.label: The invoice's lines
match.title: Three-way match
match.noorder: The invoice is not on a purchase order, so it is not matched.
match.clean: The latest match is clean: no issue.
match.issue.tax_or_total_mismatch: The tax or the total does not add up
match.issue.order_item_missing: The order has no such item
match.issue.price_variance: The price differs from the order beyond the tolerance
match.issue.quantity_exceeds_received: More is invoiced than was received
order.title: Purchase order and goods receipts
order.show: Show the purchase order and its goods receipts
receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.label: The order's goods receipts
order.refused.title: The purchase order could not be shown
document.title: Document
document.frame: The document the invoice was captured from
document.open: Open the document on its own, or download it
document.none: The invoice was not captured from a document, so there is none to show.
recs.title: Agents' recommendations
recs.none: No agent has recommended anything for this invoice.
recs.hint: A recommendation changes nothing by itself. Take the action yourself, or decide the exception's approval request, then record what you did with the recommendation.
recs.refused.title: The recommendations could not be shown
rec.kind.request_credit_note: Ask the supplier for a credit note
rec.decide.legend: What did you do with this recommendation?
rec.decide.required: Choose what you did with the recommendation.
rec.notyours: You may not decide agents' recommendations.
actions.title: What you can do
actions.none: Nothing is left to do on this invoice.
actions.notyours: You may not change this invoice in its status.
actions.pending: An exception's approval request is linked to the invoice. While it waits, someone who may approve it decides it in the approvals inbox, and releasing or cancelling the invoice by hand withdraws it; an invoice released by hand is matched again before it posts.
action.match.hint: Compares the invoice with its order and receipts. Issues put it on hold for an approval.
action.post.date.hint: Year-month-day. Empty: the invoice's posting date, or today. Its period must be open.
action.reason.hint: Required, at most 2,000 characters. It is recorded in the audit trail.
action.reverse.date.hint: Year-month-day. Empty: today. Its period must be open.
action.date.invalid: Enter a date as year-month-day, for example 2026-03-15.
invoice.refused.title: The invoice was not changed
invoice.done.title: Done
invoice.done.matched: The invoice was matched. The result is below.
invoice.done.released: The invoice is released from hold.
invoice.done.decided: Your decision on the recommendation is recorded.
problem.invoice.version_mismatch: The invoice changed since you opened it. Check it again, then try again.
problem.invoice.not_found: The invoice or the recommendation does not exist, or is not yours to see.
problem.invoice.invalid_body: The form could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
problem.invoice.validation_failed: Something in the form is not valid. Check it and try again.
problem.invoice.idempotency_key_reused: This form was already sent with other content. Reload the page and try again.
problem.invoice.request_pending: The invoice's exception waits for its approval request. Decide the request first, in the approvals inbox.
problem.invoice.period_not_open: The posting period is not open. Choose a date in an open period, or ask for the period to be opened.
problem.invoice.agent_not_allowed: Only a person may decide an agent's recommendation.
problem.payables.match_outdated: Documents posted on the order since the match change its result. Match the invoice again, then post it.
problem.payables.match_required: The invoice needs a clean match, or an approved exception, as it now stands. Match it first.
problem.payables.tax_mismatch: The tax amount does not agree with the tax calculated at the lines' tax codes. Correct the invoice, then try again.
problem.payables.invalid_status: The invoice's status does not allow this any more. The page shows it as it is now.
problem.payables.amounts_mismatch: The gross amount is not the lines' net amounts plus the tax. Correct the invoice first.
problem.payables.supplier_not_usable: The supplier is blocked for posting in this company.
problem.payables.no_purchase_order: The invoice is not on a purchase order, so there is nothing to match.
problem.payables.invoice_cleared: The invoice is paid or cleared, so it cannot be reversed.
problem.payables.invoice_in_payment_run: The invoice is in a payment run, so it cannot be reversed now.
problem.agents.already_decided: Someone has already decided this recommendation.
filter.number.hint: The ERP's document number, for example SI100001.
bank.title: Bank statements
bank.lead: The statements of your companies' house banks, line by line, matched to what the ledger holds, and each bank's reconciliation with its account in the ledger.
bank.refused.title: The statements could not be shown
bank.list.label: Bank statements
statement.gap.short: Its opening balance is not the closing balance of the statement before it. Nothing posts for this bank until the missing statement is imported.
statement.gap.title: A statement is missing before this one
statement.gap.body: This statement's opening balance is not the closing balance of the bank's statement before it. Nothing posts for this bank, automatically or by hand, until the missing statement is imported.
statement.title: Bank statement
statement.report: The bank's reconciliation with the ledger
statement.refused.title: The line was not changed
statement.reconciled.why: The statement is reconciled: its lines are decided for good.
lines.notyours: You may read this statement, but not decide its lines.
upload.title: Import a statement file
upload.file.hint: The file as the bank sent it, at most 4 MB, in UTF-8. The same file again shows what it imported before.
upload.refused.title: The file was not imported
upload.bank.required: Choose the house bank the statements are of.
upload.file.large: The file is larger than 4 MB. Ask the bank for a smaller one, or import its statements in several files.
upload.again: Choose the file again before you send the form.
bank.done.imported: The file is imported. Its statements are below.
bank.done.reimported: This file was imported before. Its statements are shown as they are now.
line.title: Line %d
line.amount.label: Amount
match.status.open: Open: for a person to decide
match.agent.hint: An agent proposed this. Its reason is shown as plain text: check it before you decide. A proposal changes nothing until a person accepts it.
match.approval.hint: The posting waits for its approval. Someone who may approve bank clearings decides it in the approvals inbox; whoever matched the line by hand may not approve it.
target.incoming: An incoming payment, to the bank's incoming payments clearing account
line.accept.hint: The line is matched or excluded as the agent proposed, as your own decision. You may not approve its posting afterwards.
line.reject.hint: The line is unmatched again, for the rules or a person. The agent does not propose for it again.
line.match.hint: Whatever the rules or the agent found, the line clears what you choose. You may not approve its posting afterwards.
line.exclude.hint: The bank's booking clears nothing the ledger holds; it is not posted.
line.post.hint: Posts the line to the bank's account against what it clears. Above the company's limit it waits for an approval first.
line.post.date.hint: Year-month-day, on or after the booking date, in an open period. Empty: the booking date.
line.post.reason.hint: Required with another date, at most 2,000 characters. It is recorded in the audit trail.
line.post.reason.required: Enter why the line posts on another date.
line.post.reason.nodate: A reason goes with another posting date: enter the date, or leave the reason empty.
line.done.pending: The line's posting waits for its approval.
recon.title: Reconciliation with the ledger
recon.lead: Each statement's closing balance against the ledger's balance of the bank's account on its closing date, and what explains the difference: lines excluded, lines not posted yet, lines posted after the date. What is left is unexplained.
recon.refused.title: The reconciliation could not be shown
recon.empty: No statement closes in the period.
recon.ledger: Ledger: balance of the bank's account
recon.noledger: None: the house bank has no main bank account
recon.intransit: Explained by lines not posted yet
recon.postedlater: Explained by lines posted after the date
problem.statement.version_mismatch: The statement changed since you opened it: a line was decided or posted. Check it again, then try again.
problem.bank.validation_failed: Something in the form is not valid. Check it and try again.
problem.bank.period_not_open: The posting date's period is not open. Post the line on a later date in an open period, with the reason.
problem.payments.statement_conflict: A statement in this file was imported before from another file: the same statement, account and number. Check that this is the file you mean.
problem.payments.statement_unreadable: The file could not be read in the format you chose. Check the format and the file, then try again.
problem.payments.statement_not_of_bank: A statement in the file is of another account or currency than the house bank's. Choose the bank the file is of.
problem.payments.statement_gap: The house bank has a statement whose opening balance does not follow the one before it. Nothing posts for the bank until the missing statement is imported.
problem.payments.statement_bank_not_post: The house bank has no main bank account in the configuration, so its lines are not posted.
problem.payments.statement_amount_differ: The payments do not pay the line's amount. Match the line to what it pays.
problem.payments.statement_posting_rule_: The company no longer has the line's posting rule. Match the line again.
problem.payments.statement_incoming_gone: The house bank no longer names an incoming payments clearing account. Match the line again.
problem.payments.statement_line_posting: The line is posted or waiting for its posting's approval, so its match stays.
problem.payments.statement_match_target: The line may not clear what you chose: a payment of another bank, currency or line, a rule the company does not have, or an incoming payment for a line that is no credit.
problem.payments.statement_reconciled: The statement is reconciled: its lines are decided for good.
problem.payments.statement_line_not_matc: Only a matched line is posted. Match it first.
problem.payments.statement_line_no_propo: The line has no open proposal any more: someone decided it, or the line was matched otherwise.
document.downloadonly: This document is not shown here: download it with the link below the frame.
payments.title: Payment runs
payments.lead: The payment runs of your companies: propose one, follow its progress, release or reject it, and send its bank files to the bank.
payments.refused.title: The payment runs could not be shown
payments.list.label: Payment runs
payments.number.hint: The run's document number, for example PR100001.
run.bank.bymethod: Chosen per payment by the suppliers' payment methods
propose.title: Propose a payment run
propose.lead: The proposal selects the open items due, leaves out what may not be paid and reserves the rest. It runs in the background; its progress is shown on the run's page.
propose.bank.any: None: each supplier's payment methods choose the bank
propose.currency.hint: Three letters (ISO 4217), for example EUR. Required without a house bank; with one, its currency.
propose.dueby: Pay the items due on or before
propose.currency.invalid: Enter the currency as three capital letters, for example EUR.
propose.refused.title: The run was not proposed
run.title: Payment run
run.refused.title: The run was not changed
run.done.proposing: The run is being proposed. Its progress is shown below; its payments follow once it is built.
run.done.releasing: The release has started. Its progress is shown below.
run.done.rejected: The run is rejected. Its items are free for a later run.
run.done.submitted: The second approval is asked for. It is decided in the approvals inbox; once it is approved, a releaser releases the run.
run.done.transmitting: The bank file is queued for the bank. Its status is shown below.
run.done.cancelled: The operation is cancelled. Work already done stays done.
run.approval.title: Second approval of the release
run.approval.lead: Above its company's limit, a run is released only once a second person, who neither proposed it nor releases it, approves the release in the approvals inbox.
run.approval.waits: The release waits for the second approval: it is offered once the request is approved.
progress.title: Progress
progress.page.title: Progress of the payment run
progress.auto: This updates on its own while the operation runs.
progress.refused.title: The progress could not be shown
progress.error.title: Why it stopped
cancel.hint: Work already done stays done. A proposal cancelled fails its run; a release cancelled leaves the run being released, to be resumed.
cancel.refused.title: The operation was not cancelled
resume.hint: The release stopped before it was done. The payments it posted stay posted; resume it to post the others and write the bank files.
run.actions.title: Release or reject
run.release.hint: Posts each payment and writes the bank files, in the background. Its progress is shown on this page.
run.reject.hint: Its items are freed for a later run.
run.submit.hint: The run is above its company's limit: a second person approves its release in the approvals inbox before it is released.
run.own: You proposed this run, so another person releases or rejects it.
run.approver: You approved this run's release, so another person releases it. You may still reject it.
run.notyours: You may read this run, but not release or reject it.
run.payments.title: Payments
run.payments.building: The payments are listed once the proposal is built.
run.exclusions.title: Left out of the run
exclusion.payment_blocked: The supplier is blocked for payment
exclusion.no_bank_account: The supplier has no bank account valid on the payment date
exclusion.bank_change_pending: A change of the supplier's bank account waits for its approval
exclusion.bank_change_hold: The supplier's bank account changed recently: it is held
exclusion.debit_balance: The supplier's items net to a debit
exclusion.item_reversed: An item was reversed since the proposal
exclusion.item_not_open: An item is no longer open
exclusion.tax_code_invalid: The down payment request's tax code is not valid on the payment date
exclusion.no_house_bank: No house bank pays the supplier's payment methods in the run's currency
run.files.title: Bank files
run.files.none: The run has no bank file yet: its release writes them.
file.transmit.hint: The file goes to the bank through the house bank's channel. A file the bank already has is not sent twice.
file.label: File
problem.run.version_mismatch: The run changed since you opened it. Check it again, then decide.
problem.run.validation_failed: Something in the form is not valid. Check it and try again.
problem.run.sod_conflict: Segregation of duties: whoever proposed a run may neither release nor reject it, and whoever approved its release may not release it.
problem.payments.currency_mismatch: The currency is not the house bank's. Leave it empty, or enter the bank's currency.
problem.payments.currency_required: Without a house bank, enter the run's currency.
problem.payments.house_bank_inactive: The house bank is no longer configured. Choose another.
problem.payments.legal_entity_not_active: The company is not active, so it pays nothing.
problem.ledger.no_fiscal_period: The payment date is in no fiscal period of the company.
problem.payments.invalid_status: The run's status does not allow this any more. Check the run again.
problem.payments.nothing_to_pay: Every payment's items were reversed or cleared since the proposal: nothing is left to pay. Reject the run.
problem.payments.proposal_outdated: The proposal is out of date: a supplier or an item changed since it was made. Reject the run and propose again.
problem.payments.discount_lapsed: A payment takes a cash discount whose last day has passed. Reject the run and propose again.
problem.payments.release_approval_requir: The run is above its company's limit: a second person approves its release first. Ask for the second approval below.
problem.payments.release_approval_pendin: The second approval is asked for and waits in the approvals inbox.
problem.payments.release_approval_outdat: The run's total is now above the total that was approved. Ask for the second approval again.
problem.payments.release_already_approve: The release is approved for this total already: release the run.
problem.payments.release_approval_not_re: The run is within its company's limit: release it directly.
problem.payments.release_in_progress: The release is under way. Its progress is shown on the run's page.
problem.payments.release_role_missing: You do not hold the role that releases payment runs.
problem.ledger.no_exchange_rate: No exchange rate converts the run's currency on the payment date, so the run cannot be measured against its company's limit.
problem.ledger.item_reserved: An item of the run is reserved by another operation. Try again in a moment.
problem.platform.operation_not_cancellab: The operation has already finished, so there is nothing to cancel.
close.title: Period close
close.lead: The posting periods of a company and ledger: open, close and lock them, ask for a locked period's unlock, check before closing, and revalue foreign currency at a period's end.
close.revalue: Foreign-currency revaluation of this company and ledger
period.year.invalid: Enter the fiscal year as four digits, for example 2026.
periods.refused.title: The periods could not be shown
periods.empty: This company and ledger have no period in this fiscal year.
periods.caption: Posting periods
period.heading: Period %d of %s
period.title: Posting period
period.actions.title: Open, close or lock
period.open.hint: Opening the period lets entries dated in it be posted again.
period.close.hint: Closing the period stops postings dated in it; it can be opened again until it is locked. Look at the pre-close checks first.
period.lock.hint: Locking is for good: a locked period is not opened again, and only an unlock the controller approves returns it to closed.
period.unlock.hint: The controller decides the unlock in the approvals inbox. Once it is approved the period is closed again; opening it is a separate step.
period.unlock.reason: Why the period is to be unlocked
period.unlock.title: Unlock requested
period.unlock.waits: The unlock waits for the controller's approval in the approvals inbox. Whoever asked for it may not approve it.
period.notyours: You may read this period, but not change its status.
period.done.unlock: The unlock is asked for. It waits for the controller's approval.
period.refused.title: The period was not changed
period.revalue.lead: Value the foreign-currency open items and balances at the period's last day, before closing it.
period.revalue: Preview the revaluation at the period's end
checks.title: Pre-close checks
checks.lead: What to look at before the period is closed. The checks read the figures as they stand now.
checks.refused.title: The check could not be run
check.more: There are more than are shown here.
check.grir.title: GR/IR positions still open
check.grir.lead: Purchase order items received and not invoiced, or invoiced and not received, in the leading ledger.
check.grir.none: Every order item's receipts and invoices agree.
check.ledger.title: Ledger reconciliation
check.ledger.lead: Ledger %s compared with ledger %s in this period.
check.ledger.single: The company keeps one ledger: there is nothing to reconcile.
check.ledger.unknown: The company's ledgers could not be read, so they are not reconciled here.
check.ledger.none: No account differs between the two ledgers.
check.trial.balanced: Debits and credits net to zero
check.trial.unbalanced: Debits and credits do not net to zero
check.statements.title: Bank statements not reconciled
check.statements.none: Every bank statement of the company is reconciled.
check.statements.gap: Every statement with a gap before it
revaluation.title: Foreign-currency revaluation
revaluation.lead: Values a company's open items and flagged balances in foreign currency at a key date, the last day of a period, and posts the differences with their reset on the next day.
preview.title: Preview a revaluation
revaluation.keydate.hint: The last day of a period, as year-month-day.
preview.result.title: What the revaluation would value
preview.refused.title: The revaluation could not be previewed
preview.nothing: Nothing is valued: no open item or flagged balance is in a foreign currency on the key date.
revaluation.totals.title: Totals per account, currency and direction
revaluation.nodifference: No item has a difference: the run posts no entry.
revaluation.items.title: Items valued
revaluation.post.hint: Posting the run posts the valuation entry on the key date and its reset on the next day, in this ledger alone. Both periods must be open.
revaluation.post.refused.title: The revaluation was not posted
revaluation.runs.title: The company's revaluations
revaluation.runs.refused.title: The revaluations could not be shown
revaluation.run.title: Revaluation
revaluation.entries.title: Entries
revaluation.entry.valuation: Valuation entry, on the key date
revaluation.entry.reset: Reset entry, on the next day
revaluation.noentries: No item had a difference, so the run posted no entry.
problem.period.version_mismatch: The period changed since you opened it. Check it again, then decide.
problem.ledger.invalid_period_status: The period's status does not allow this: an open period is closed, a closed one opened or locked, and a locked one's unlock asked for.
problem.ledger.unlock_pending: An unlock of this period is asked for already and waits for its approval.
problem.workflow.no_policy: No approval policy decides period unlocks here. The configuration needs one.
problem.workflow.unknown_role: The role that approves period unlocks is not set up.
problem.ledger.key_date_not_period_end: The key date is not the last day of a posting period of the ledger.
problem.ledger.ledger_not_kept: The company does not keep this ledger.
problem.revaluation.no_exchange_rate: No exchange rate of the valuation rate type converts a currency on the key date. Record the rate, then preview again.
problem.ledger.rate_stale: A rate of the valuation rate type is valid from before the key date's period, so it is out of date. Record the period's rate.
problem.ledger.revaluation_account_missi: An account with items to value has no valuation accounts in the configuration.
problem.ledger.revaluation_exists: A revaluation of this company, ledger and key date is posted already: it is listed below.
problem.revaluation.period_not_open: The key date's period or the next one is not open in this ledger, so the run cannot post.
journal.title: Manual journal entries
journal.lead: Entries parked to be posted, yours and the agents' proposals, by status. An entry above the company's limit is posted once another person approves it in the approvals inbox.
journal.entries: Browse the journal of posted entries
parked.empty: No entry is in this list.
parked.refused.title: The entries could not be shown
parked.card.title: %s entry of %s
parked.owner.none: No one yet: an agent's proposal
parked.title: Parked entry
parked.heading: %s entry of %s
parked.journal: Open the journal entry it was posted as
parked.actions.title: Change, post or cancel
parked.takeon.title: An agent's proposal
parked.takeon: An agent parked this entry and no person owns it yet. If you change, post or cancel it, you take it on: it becomes yours, and another person approves it above the limit.
parked.others: Only its owner changes, posts or cancels this entry.
parked.readonly: You may read this entry, but not change or post it.
parked.waits: The entry waits for another person's approval in the approvals inbox.
parked.waits.yours: The entry waits for another person's approval in the approvals inbox. You asked for it, so you may not approve it; you may withdraw the request, which parks the entry again.
parked.post.hint: Within the company's limit for manual entries the entry is posted at once; above it, it waits for another person's approval and is posted when they approve it. Its period must be open.
parked.cancel.hint: Cancelling is for good: nothing was posted, so nothing is reversed.
parked.withdraw.hint: The entry is parked again: you may change it and post it once more.
parked.decision.refused.title: The entry was not changed
parked.done.parked: The entry is parked. Post it when it is ready.
parked.done.uploaded: The file's lines replace the entry's lines.
parked.done.submitted: The entry is above the company's limit: it waits for another person's approval.
parked.done.withdrawn: The approval request is withdrawn: the entry is parked again.
upload.lines.title: Replace the lines from a CSV file
upload.lines.lead: The file's lines replace the entry's lines as a whole. Its first row names the columns: account and amount, and as needed cost_center, profit_center, segment, partner, tax_code and line_text. Separate them with commas or semicolons; write amounts as in the form.
upload.lines.file.hint: UTF-8, at most 4 MB and 10,000 lines.
upload.lines.rows: Rows of the file to correct

upload.lines.more.one: %d more row is to be corrected.
upload.lines.more.other: %d more rows are to be corrected.

upload.lines.refused.title: The lines were not replaced
csv.file.large: The file is larger than 4 MB. Split the entry's lines over a smaller file.
csv.utf8: The file is not in UTF-8. Save it again as CSV UTF-8.
csv.header: The file has no first row naming its columns.
csv.column.unknown: The first row names a column twice, or one the file does not take: account, amount, cost_center, profit_center, segment, partner, tax_code and line_text.
csv.column.missing: The first row must name the account and amount columns.
csv.unreadable: A row of the file could not be read: check its quotes.
csv.rows.many: The file has more than 10,000 lines.
csv.rows.none: The file has no line under its first row.
entry.new.title: New manual entry
entry.edit.title: Change a parked entry
entry.form.lead: The entry is parked, not posted: you post it from its page once it is ready. It is checked as a posting is, except for the period and the exchange rates.
entry.nocompany: There is no company you may enter an entry in.
entry.header.title: The entry
entry.doctype.hint: Two letters or digits; SA for a general entry.
entry.doctype.invalid: Enter the document type as two letters or digits, for example SA.
entry.postingdate.hint: Year-month-day. Its period must be open when the entry is posted.
entry.taxdate.hint: Year-month-day, if the tax codes' rates of another day apply. Empty: the posting date.
entry.currency.hint: Three letters (ISO 4217), for example EUR: every line's amount is in it.
entry.reference.long: A reference has at most 40 characters.
entry.text.long: A text has at most 200 characters.
entry.lines.hint: Debit positive, credit negative, without grouping: 1200.00 or -1200.00. The account by its number, centers and segment by code, the partner by number. A line left empty is left out.
entry.lines.few: An entry has at least two lines.
entry.line.heading: Line %d
entry.refused.title: The entry was not saved
entry.account.unknown: No account of the company's chart has this number.
entry.amount.invalid: Enter the amount as digits with at most one decimal sign and no grouping, for example 1200.00 or -1200.00.
entry.amount.zero: A line's amount is never zero.
entry.code.invalid: A code has at most 10 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
entry.taxcode.invalid: A tax code has 1 to 4 letters or digits.
entry.costcenter.unknown: The company has no cost center with this code.
entry.profitcenter.unknown: The company has no profit center with this code.
entry.segment.unknown: There is no segment with this code.
entry.partner.unknown: There is no partner with this number.
entry.lookup.failed: This could not be looked up just now. Send the form again.
entry.line.refused: This line: refused by the ERP (%s).
entries.title: Journal
entries.lead: Posted entries of a company and ledger, latest first. Filter by the centers a line carries, by number or by posting date.
entries.empty: No posted entry matches the filters.
entries.refused.title: The journal could not be shown
entry.title: Journal entry
entry.heading: Entry %s
entry.rate.line: %s to the company's currency, %s to the group's
entry.parked: Open the parked entry it was posted for
entry.reversedby: Open the entry that reversed it
entry.reverse.title: Reverse the entry
entry.reverse.hint: The reversal posts every amount negated and clears the entry's open items against it. An entry is reversed once; one another document owns is reversed with that document.
entry.reverse.date.hint: Year-month-day, in an open period. Empty: the entry's own date, if its period is open.
entry.notyours: You may read this entry, but not reverse it.
entry.reverse.refused.title: The entry was not reversed
entry.done.reversed: The reversal is posted: this is it.
problem.ledger.unbalanced: The lines do not balance: the debits and credits must net to zero.
problem.ledger.account_not_postable: An account cannot be posted to in this company: it is not in its chart, or it is blocked.
problem.ledger.partner_required: A line on a supplier or customer account needs its partner.
problem.ledger.partner_not_allowed: A line names a partner on an account that takes none.
problem.ledger.partner_not_postable: A partner cannot be posted to: it is not set up in this company, or it is blocked.
problem.ledger.cost_center_required: A line on an expense account needs a cost center, and the account has none by default.
problem.ledger.cost_center_invalid: A cost center cannot take its line: the line says why.
problem.ledger.profit_center_invalid: A profit center cannot take its line: the line says why.
problem.ledger.profit_center_mismatch: A line's profit center is not its cost center's: leave it empty, or enter the cost center's.
problem.ledger.segment_mismatch: A line's segment is not its profit center's: leave it empty.
problem.ledger.unknown_tax_code: A tax code is not one of the company's.
problem.ledger.automatic_account: A line is on the company's GR/IR account, which only goods receipts and invoices post.
problem.ledger.amount_too_large: The amounts are larger than the ledger takes.
problem.request.invalid_amount: An amount has more or fewer decimals than its currency's.
problem.entry.no_exchange_rate: No exchange rate converts the entry's currency on its posting date.
problem.entry.period_not_open: The posting date's period is not open.
problem.entry.no_fiscal_period: The posting date is in no fiscal period of the company.
problem.ledger.invalid_parked_status: The entry is no longer parked: it waits for approval, or it was posted, rejected or cancelled.
problem.ledger.not_entry_owner: Only the entry's owner changes, posts or cancels it.
problem.entry.version_mismatch: The entry changed since you opened it. What you typed is kept; check it against the entry as it is now and send it again.
problem.entry.request_pending: The entry already waits for approval.
problem.entry.no_policy: No approval applies to manual entries above the limit. Ask the ERP administrator.
problem.entry.unknown_role: The role that approves manual entries does not exist. Ask the ERP administrator.
problem.workflow.not_requester: Only the person who asked for the approval withdraws it.
problem.ledger.cannot_reverse_reversal: A reversal is not reversed: post a new entry instead.
problem.ledger.entry_owned_elsewhere: Another document owns this entry, such as a supplier invoice or a goods receipt: reverse that document instead.
problem.ledger.entry_is_copy: This is a parallel ledger's copy: reverse the first entry of its posting.
problem.ledger.entry_cleared: The entry's open items are cleared: reset the clearing first.
problem.config.no_number_range: The company has no number range for this document type in this year. Ask the ERP administrator.
entry.codes.many: The entry names more partners, or accounts and centers beyond the company's first 500, than are looked up at once. Name them by their ids, or upload fewer lines at a time.
entry.lookup.refused: You may not look this up: it needs a permission you do not have.
csv.fields.extra: A row of the file has more fields than its first row names columns.
csv.rows.few: The file has one line under its first row: an entry has at least two.
